marketing_description: The Milwaukee® QUIK LOK™ HOLE DOZER™ 12-Piece Hole Saw Kit (part number 49-22-4702) includes 9 bi-metal hole saws featuring Matrix II bi-metal teeth, a 1-5/8 inch cutting depth, and saw diameters ranging from 3/4 to 2-1/2 inches. Engineered to cut aluminum, metal, nail-embedded wood, plastic, stainless steel, and wood, these saws utilize a Rip Guard 3.5 TPI tooth design and a Plug Jack all-access slot design for quick plug removal. The included QUIK-LOK arbor enables fast, tool-free blade changes, and the kit integrates with the PACKOUT compact organizer for jobsite transportation and organization.
